# Gaming Toggles for PC by MAECLY

> Free and open-source Stream Deck plugin for two Windows 11 gaming settings.

## Canonical pages

- [Spanish landing](https://gaming-toggles.maecly.com/)
- [English landing](https://gaming-toggles.maecly.com/en/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/MAECLY/gaming-toggles)
- [Latest installer](https://github.com/MAECLY/gaming-toggles/releases/latest)
- [Support](https://github.com/MAECLY/gaming-toggles/issues)

## Capabilities

- Toggle Windows 11 Game Mode (`AutoGameModeEnabled`).
- Toggle whether the controller Xbox/Nexus button opens Game Bar (`UseNexusForGameBarEnabled`).
- Reflect external Windows Settings changes on Stream Deck every 2.5 seconds.
- Spanish and English localization.

## Trust

- MIT licensed, source available on GitHub.
- Per-user HKCU settings; no administrator permission required.
- GitHub Actions build and SHA-256 checksum for Releases.
- Independent project; not affiliated with Microsoft, Xbox, Elgato, or Corsair.
